name: Focused-ultrasound BBB opening to deliver ADCs and radioligands to glioma
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "FUS-BBB opening immediately before ADC or radioconjugate infusion achieves therapeutic intratumoural concentrations and objective responses in recurrent glioblastoma."
fields.after: "Opening the blood-brain barrier with focused ultrasound immediately before ADC or radioconjugate infusion achieves therapeutic intratumoural concentrations and objective responses in recurrent glioblastoma."
